subject_lines: Your new seasonal favorite has arrived ☕
Exclusive taste test: Try it before anyone else
Limited-time seasonal drink, just for Rewards members
preheader: A new seasonal drink crafted for you — available now, exclusively for Starbucks Rewards members.
mjml:
<mjml>
  <mj-head>
    <mj-attributes>
      <mj-text font-size="16px" font-family="Sodo Sans, Arial, sans-serif" color="#333333" />
      <mj-button font-size="16px" font-family="Sodo Sans, Arial, sans-serif" />
    </mj-attributes>
  </mj-head>
  <mj-body background-color="#FFFFFF">
    <!-- Hero Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#00704A" padding="60px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="32px" font-weight="bold" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0 0 10px 0">
          It Starts With You
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="28px" font-weight="bold" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0 0 20px 0">
          Meet Your New Seasonal Obsession
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0 0 30px 0">
          Our baristas crafted something special — a drink that captures the essence of the season in every sip.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-button background-color="#FFFFFF" color="#00704A" href="https://www.starbucks.com" font-weight="bold" border-radius="50px" padding="0">
          Order Now
        </mj-button>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Product Image Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="40px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-image src="https://about.starbucks.com/uploads/2026/02/StarbucksReserve_DoubleMatchaMargarita-1536x1536.jpg" alt="New seasonal Starbucks drink" width="300px" align="center" />
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Body Copy Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="20px 20px 40px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" align="center" padding="0 0 25px 0" line-height="1.6">
          Rich, indulgent flavors with a hint of something seasonal — it's the kind of drink you'll want to make a ritual. Available for a limited time, exclusively for Rewards members.
        </mj-text>
        <mj-button background-color="#00704A" color="#FFFFFF" href="https://www.starbucks.com" font-weight="bold" border-radius="50px" align="center">
          Get It Before It's Gone
        </mj-button>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Gold Accent Divider -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="0 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-divider border-color="#CBA258" border-width="3px" border-style="solid" width="80px" />
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Accent Message Section -->
    <mj-section background-color="#CBA258" padding="30px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="18px" font-weight="bold" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="0">
          Rewards members get it first
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="16px" color="#FFFFFF" align="center" padding="10px 0 0 0">
          Your exclusive access starts now.
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <mj-section background-color="#FFFFFF" padding="40px 20px 60px 20px">
      <mj-column>
        <mj-text font-size="14px" color="#999999" align="center" padding="0 0 10px 0">
          Starbucks Coffee Company
        </mj-text>
        <mj-text font-size="12px" color="#999999" align="center" padding="0">
          It starts with you
        </mj-text>
      </mj-column>
    </mj-section>
  </mj-body>
</mjml>
rationale: This email opens with a bold green hero section featuring the brand tagline and headline to immediately capture attention and reinforce the Starbucks identity. The product image follows in a clean white section to showcase the new seasonal drink, then two strategically placed CTA buttons—one in the hero and one after the product—create multiple conversion opportunities. The gold accent section adds visual rhythm and emphasizes the exclusive member benefit, while the minimal footer grounds the email with subtle branding without distraction.
